name: ILIVEON.VR-Theater
summary:
ILIVEON.VR-Theater Player App allows you to watch your Digital Stories (produced with our Creator App) in Virtual Reality (VR) mode. 

Just load a Story ILO File (produced with I-LIVE-ON's Creator App, available from https://i-live-on.com/pages/creator-app ), pick your VR environment and then enjoy the presentation.

I-LIVE-ON's StoryTeller System lets you create Stories using your own information (including Pictures, Videos, Documents and Sound) from your Computer, and then makes it super easy for the Stor
